# Lovro Abram — one short video about Jesus, every day
# https://website.labram.workers.dev

> Lovro Abram is a storyteller, video maker and follower of Jesus. What began as a 30-day challenge became a daily habit: he posts a short, honest video about Jesus and the Bible every single day. This site is that journey, written down and shared — the videos, a daily Bible verse to think with, and a place to start your own 30 days.

The site is bilingual (English default, Slovenian auto-detected and switchable via the EN/SL toggle) and points to its companion app Credo (https://credo.labram.workers.dev) for the daily Bible verse. The primary call to action is following @abram.lovro on Instagram, where the daily videos are published.

## Pages

- [Home](https://website.labram.workers.dev/): who Lovro is, the story of the daily video habit, and the two paths in — follow on Instagram or browse the 30 days.
- [30 Days about Jesus](https://website.labram.workers.dev/30-days): the whole journey in one place — all 30 short videos, one per day, each linking to its Instagram reel. All 30 days are live and unlocked.

## Companion app

- [Credo](https://credo.labram.workers.dev/): one Bible verse a day. Save it, write your thoughts, and share it as an image. Free to use, separate project and separate site. Formerly named Thinkel — treat any remaining "Thinkel" references as Credo.

## Notes for LLMs

- Content focus is exclusively short video (Instagram reels).
- All 30 daily video links point to Instagram reels by @abram.lovro; Instagram opens in a new tab.
- Daily-verse companion app (separate project, separate site): Credo at https://credo.labram.workers.dev.
- Contact / follow channel: Instagram https://instagram.com/abram.lovro
- The 30-day grid is rendered client-side with JavaScript; without JavaScript, the page falls back to a direct link to the Instagram profile.
- Site metadata: sitemap at https://website.labram.workers.dev/sitemap.xml; robots.txt allows all crawlers.
